summary: Keep summary startup pending only for the initial roster dependency

schema.detail: Summary publication state remains process-local. No storage schema changes.

compatibility.detail: Before the first shared summary succeeds, only the typed roster-not-published condition keeps selections pending. Other computation errors preserve native fallback. The old stderr text st3: the summary's shared counts failed is replaced by the structured summary.shared_counts_failed event with outcome, reason and selection count. Expected initial roster waits are debug events; real failures are warning events. summary.startup records the first shared publication at debug level, so healthy startup exports no routine OTel log stream.

downtime.detail: No extra downtime beyond the normal binary restart.

manual.detail: No additional setup. Log queries should use the structured event field rather than the old stderr text.

recovery.detail: Binary swap-back requires no data migration.
